as_told.title: Miethe and the Avro Canada Avrocar

plain: Michels says an aerospace engineer named Richard Miethe, a man he says the physicist Townsend Brown had captured, ended up in Canada in the 1950s working on the Avrocar, a saucer-shaped aircraft project, alongside an engineer named John Frost. Michels tells this himself on three episodes, and the details shift: once he speaks of "evidence" and says the project ran "in partnership with the American CIA," once he says "by most accounts" and leaves out the CIA, and once he calls Miethe's part in it only "speculation." If true, it would tie German saucer know-how to a Western flying-disc project.
